No document moves and no link repair is needed: the tree already passes the documentation check.

declarations.coverage: This declaration changes only remote GitHub configuration through its two authored fixes, canonical labels and pull request integration, so its project-content scope is intentionally empty. The repository identity is unambiguous: the single `origin` remote is `https://github.com/lutzseverino/repo-canon`, the repository this adoption runs in, whose labels, required `PR metadata` check, and squash-only merge settings the maintainer authorizes through the confirmation of this inspection.

This repository is a single standards source with one root manifest, `package.json`, and one set of development commands, and it has no nested Project. Every nested directory is standards source, executable tooling, tests and fixtures, vendored third-party material, documentation, or installed agent material. There is therefore no non-root Project README to propose, and the scope is intentionally empty.
